## Description

Imported B-reps regularly contain pairs of vertices and edges that the designer intended to be the same but which sit a few microns apart due to translator round-off. Coordinates agree to 1e-4 but topology stores them as distinct entities — a "crack" rather than a "gap" because geometric distance is zero by some metrics yet topology is broken.

## Reproducer recipe

STEP file from translator A whose two adjacent `ADVANCED_FACE`s each instantiate their own `VERTEX_POINT` for the corner; coordinates agree to 1e-4.

## Expected kernel behavior

heal — stitch by spatial proximity within tolerance; merge duplicate vertices and split/reconcile edges.

- allowed: `heal`
